exploreDE: instructions for an AI assistant

Source: SKILLS.md

The instructions for helping a user build an exploreDE .h5ad from their own data live in inst/skills/exploreDE-byod/SKILL.md. From an installed package:

system.file("skills/exploreDE-byod/SKILL.md", package = "exploreDE")

The human-oriented guide is vignette("bring-your-own-data", package = "exploreDE").

The file formats are specified in inst/spec/:

  • exploreDE-h5ad-1.0.md: The .h5ad layout, for writing files outside R.
  • exploreDE-session-2.md: The saved-session .json file.

Developed by Peter Leary, Witold Wolski.
